subject: Current style/design exploration is far below convergence threshold; expand the experiment space before any winner or promotion decision
user_judgment: The current style experiments and design experiments are still far from sufficient.
correction: Do not treat Dawn Atlas, Living Current, Signal Nocturne, homepage-v1/v2/v3, or product-candidate-comparison-v1 as a near-final shortlist. They are only early probes into a much larger design space.
instructions: Suspend winner selection and production promotion. Browser verification of current experiments may continue as learning evidence, but it must not imply convergence.

Expand both STYLE exploration and DESIGN exploration. Style means visual/material/typographic/mood language; design means information architecture, spatial composition, navigation, hierarchy, interaction, motion, editorial behavior, image-text system, responsive transformation, threshold/entry experience, and relationship among Journal, ONE, Church, Library and Join.
Generate materially different experiment families rather than minor variants of the current three. Avoid local optimization around their existing visual grammar.
Use the visual-learning and Storybook research channels to seek genuinely different high-quality references and translate principles rather than copy appearances.

Include experiments that challenge current assumptions: light vs dark, image-led vs type-led vs spatial/architectural, dense editorial vs contemplative, continuous narrative vs portal/city structures, static print-derived vs motion-led, monumental vs intimate, classical vs contemporary, and alternative bilingual typography systems where appropriate.
Use real Westside content in later-stage experiments so visual attractiveness cannot hide information-architecture failure.
Record accepted/rejected patterns and reasons, but do not promote temporary preferences into permanent brand rules without user confirmation.

Doré may participate autonomously in research, Storybook experiments, browser evidence and capability repair. If a product friction reveals a reusable Doré gap, repair the smallest reusable capability and resume this same parent goal.
Do not declare WESTSIDE_FIT/product PASS merely because an experiment passes technical gates. Technical fitness, Doré internal judgment, and user aesthetic acceptance are separate states.
required_next_evidence: multiple genuinely distinct new style families
real-content stress tests for promising directions
explicit diversity audit proving experiments are materially different rather than palette/layout tweaks
clear rejected-pattern learning as well as accepted-pattern learning
stop_condition: Do not converge or promote until exploration breadth is materially larger and user feedback provides evidence that a direction is worth deepening.
